spells.name: Absolute Zero
spells.desc: Stop every molecule in the target's body. The world whites out, a crystal lattice locks around them, and time itself freezes before the shatter. Deals HEAVY magic damage to a Single Enemy and FREEZES them solid. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

spells.name: Static Shock
spells.desc: A crack of static across the gap. MEDIUM magic damage, and the jolt scrambles their link (Jammed for 2 rounds).

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.desc: Conjure a 3-tile wall of flame in a line (horizontal or vertical). Damages enemies caught on the ground (flyers up in the sky are above it), burns them for 2 turns — and the wall KEEPS BURNING for 3 rounds: it scorches anyone standing in or crossing it, and the fire can spread through grass and trees.

spells.name: Love Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Lowers the target's DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Nimble Dodge
spells.desc: Gracefully dash 2 tiles away and vanish for 1 turn. Perfect evasive maneuver. Needs 3 rounds between dodges.

spells.name: Meow
spells.desc: An adorable, disarming meow. All enemies within 2 tiles have their DEF lowered for 2 turns. Deals no damage.

spells.name: Ninefold Scratch
spells.desc: Nine lives, nine scratches. Deals SEVERE physical damage to a Single Enemy across 9 hits.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Go. Runs up to 3 tiles in a straight line.

spells.name: Ram Charge
Transform
spells.desc: Stand up into the combat platform: −3 SPD, +1 DEF and +2 M DEF stages, +2 RNG. Or fold back down.

spells.name: Hydraulic Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Jammed targets.

spells.name: Vehicular Manslaughter
spells.desc: It was an accident. Four times. Drives through every enemy in the lane for HEAVY physical damage. Deals bonus damage to Discorded targets.

spells.name: Hydraulic Punch
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Exhaust Cloud
spells.desc: Pump toxic exhaust in a 3x3 cloud for 2 turns. Enemies inside are confused.

spells.name: Swing Door
spells.desc: Mind the door. Shoot a door onto an EMPTY tile beside an enemy within 3 — the hinge — and it swings through them: WEAK physical damage, Staggered, and they are pushed 2 tiles straight away from the hinge. Pick the hinge on the far side and you pick where they land.

spells.name: Breaking and Entering
spells.desc: Nobody said the door had to be yours. Shoot a door down beside an enemy within 4 tiles you can see and come through it: WEAK physical damage, always a rear attack.

spells.name: Underdog Spirit
spells.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

spells.name: Drop In
spells.desc: Uninvited. Shoot a door into the air over an enemy within 5 tiles you can see and drop out of it onto them: HEAVY physical damage, always a rear attack, worse on a Staggered target, and every other enemy beside the landing takes WEAK physical damage from the slam.

spells.name: Elbow Grease
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. No tricks, no magic — just honest work.

spells.name: Air Mail
spells.desc: Return to sender. Shoot a door at an enemy within 4 tiles: they go in, and a door opens three storeys over their head for them to fall out of. MEDIUM physical damage from the landing, flyers are grounded, the target is Staggered.

spells.name: Door Dash
spells.desc: Take the short cut. Shoot a door onto an empty tile within 5, step into a door at your feet and out of that one. No damage, no opportunity strikes — you were never in between.

spells.name: Divine Light
spells.desc: Restores a BIG amount of HP to a Single Ally, and every enemy standing next to that ally takes WEAK light damage.

spells.name: Miracle
spells.desc: Swap places with an ally within 4 tiles; the ally arrives healed for a MEDIUM amount of HP.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.desc: Consecrate a 3x3 area for 2 turns. Allies standing in it heal each round.

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY magic damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Unholy targets. Breaks it for 1 round (its passives are off; a passive flyer falls). The full weight of heaven, delivered.

spells.name: Aurora Ray
spells.desc: Deals WEAK magic damage to All Enemies in an AOE. Lowers DEF by 1 stage. Deals bonus damage to targets with Stun.

spells.name: Smite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy, and bonus damage to Unholy targets.

spells.name: Contract
spells.desc: Binds a Single Enemy in an infernal contract for 3 turns: every time they deal damage, the demon collects 40% of it as healing. The fine print always favors the fiend.

spells.name: Infernal Hurl
spells.desc: Grabs the target, carries it skyward and hurls it up to 3 tiles. Deals WEAK physical damage, more if they crash into another unit. Caster must be flying.

spells.name: Devour Soul
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Contract or Soul-Bound. Heals the caster for part of the damage dealt.

spells.name: Hellmouth
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY magic damage to All Enemies in a line. Leaves lava tiles behind.

spells.name: Demonic Roar
spells.desc: Terrifying roar. All enemies within 2 tiles are Feared for a round.

spells.name: Shadow Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Slow.

spells.name: Hydraulic Crush
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Jammed targets.

spells.name: Hydraulic Punch
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Jammed. Knocks the target back 2 tiles.

spells.name: Vehicular Manslaughter
spells.desc: It was an accident. Four times. Drives through every enemy in the lane for HEAVY physical damage. Deals bonus damage to Discorded targets.

spells.name: Transform
spells.desc: Stand up into the combat platform: −3 SPD, +1 DEF and +2 M DEF stages, +2 RNG. Or fold back down.

spells.name: Kill Mode
spells.desc: Weapons free. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies around the caster (AOE). Slowed targets take it worse. Upgrades: Empowered (+15 % damage).

spells.name: Laser Door
spells.desc: A door to the neon city. Shoot it onto an empty tile within 4 and turn it to face a line: a red beam runs straight out of it until a wall or a shut door stops it. A PRISM on its path turns it a quarter turn (toward the side with more enemies), up to 3 turns. Every enemy on the beam takes a tech blast (STRONG); your own side is never hit. It fires when it lands, again at the end of every round, and on any enemy who steps onto or walks across the beam. 3 hits to break; two standing doors per player.

spells.name: Hell Door
spells.desc: A door to the pit of Hell. Shoot it onto an empty tile within 4 and turn it to face a lane: a tongue of lava licks 3 tiles out of it. The lane's ground BURNS for 2 rounds (anyone knocked or walking onto it burns, as on any fire), and every enemy in the lane takes a fire blast (MODERATE) and Burn 2. It melts a Frost Door's ice. It blasts when it lands and again at the end of every round. 3 hits to break; two standing doors per player.

spells.name: Underdog Spirit
spells.desc: Nobody believed in you. Good. Raises the caster's ATK by 2 stages and cleanses a debuff.

spells.name: Archers' Door
spells.desc: A door to Camelot's walls. Shoot it onto an empty tile within 4: Robin Hood's archers loose a volley of 3 arrows (WEAK physical each) at the nearest enemy within 4 they can see — when it lands, again at the end of every round, and at once on an enemy who steps or is knocked into range. It moves nobody: it punishes the body you pinned. 3 hits to break; two standing doors per player.

spells.name: Breaking and Entering
spells.desc: Nobody said the door had to be yours. Shoot a door down beside an enemy within 4 tiles you can see and come through it: WEAK physical damage, always a rear attack.
